sources.sourceText:
～ 13:00 英語で発声練習

このゲームの凄い所は❗発売され10年以上たっても全く色褪せない物語＆脳筋エルデンリング？と思っていたchが時の魔法によりホワイトアルバム同志だとわかり更に素晴らしいセトリ歌すらも聞ける多様連続性ですかね🎶

❄️超しんどい『氷の刃』は置いといて… 歌詞なしでの私が好きなBGMタイトルが→『綺麗で儚いもの』『言葉にできない想い』『静かな冬の夜』(武也ルートのあの場面曲)でいずれも最高ですね☃️

Ayyyyy Yuzusoft song this time yes!!!
I already read most of the titles except for Noble Works, Amairo Islenaut. While I am still on pause for Tenshi Souzou where I only have Fumika and Noa route left to read. sources.sourceText:
Tonight I really had fun listening to classic songs from Da Capo series especially since I only play Da Capo 2 and only finish Nanaka route. That's why when at 1:26:49 "Especially", I was so hyped. As this is one of the best OP I heard from Da Capo 2. And at 2:08:19, I remember and enjoy this song as this is actually sung in Nanaka route on her school concert. Since I only finished Nanaka route, this song really nostalgic for me. At 2:19:09 "Time Will Shine", I remember in Nanaka route, where Nanaka and Koko arguing about Yoshiyuki as Koko already harbor some romantic feeling towards Yoshiyuki for a long time but it's already too late since Yoshiyuki chooses to be with Nanaka and this song was played at that particular scene. And most importantly, I really really thank you so much for singing 1:48:46 "If...~I wish~" as this song is a song I always enjoy when I'm feeling sad (although I have no girlfriend 😂) but seeing Otome sad in this ED song really hits right in the kokoro. That's why when you sing "If ~I wish~", I sing along with you, feeling the song as I am feeling it when I played Da Capo 2 😭
Thank you for bringing back such good classics for me to enjoy tonight 👏😭

sources.sourceText: There is a lot of good songs you sing tonight and some of them are my favourite such as SOUND OF DESTINY at 14:33. Tegami by Duca at 23:09 is actually a song that I just downloaded recently and I enjoy it so much. I also love you sing Sakura, Moyu by Kanako, my favourite lullaby song at 43:14, it's a sad song but I still love the song and listen to it from time to time. TIME WILL SHINE from Da Capo 2 is also one of my favourite classics at 1:26:24. I remember this song is played when Koko and Nanaka fought for Yoshiyuki as I went through Nanaka route and I miss this song already. With the recent release for English translation of Mashiro-Iro Symphony in STEAM, I just got to know this song at 1:47:43 just recently too. Despite already watched this anime but someday I'd like to play other heroines route too. Last but not least, the song Close Your Eyes at 2:17:00 is also one of my go to song to listen to, I haven't played G Senjou no Maou but this song is just that powerful and I hum along with this song too, especially when you sing it on this stream. As always I am so glad I catch up again with your Visual Novel singing stream tonight, will looking forward to next stream. Otsukaresama Rara-chan 👏

sources.sourceText:
いつものように、今夜はとても楽しかったです、特に今回は配信をクイズ形式にしました。
外国人は私だけかも知れませんが、私がどれだけ興奮しているか皆さんは分かっていないでしょう。
30:47 のアストラル能力で始まり、ダンスの途中で切れてしまいました😂、40:29からは私の個人的なクラシックです。 私は今でもアニメ版の方が好きですが、この曲は私のお気に入りの古典の 1 つなので、今でも大好きです。
あ、村雨のキャラソンは 1:07:05、吉乃のキャラソンは 1:12:41 です。 LET'S GOOOOOOOOO!!!! あと、マコとレナのキャラソンが一番好きです。
ゆずソフトは本当に良い曲がたくさんあって本当に楽しかったです。
数日前の 1:19:41 に「Dear My Precious」をダウンロードしたばかりなので、今夜聴くのがとても楽しみです
そして、1:39:02 の涙を誘う歌で終わり、ララにスタンディングオベーションが起こります 😭
今夜は素晴らしいノスタルジア ビジュアル ノベル ソング ストリームをありがとうございました。 次のストリームを楽しみにしています
(Google翻訳を使っているので日本語が間違っていたらごめんなさい🙏)

sources.sourceText:
I haven't yet to play both Summer Pockets and Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE, but I so enjoy the songs at 9:05 and 19:08. I am so happy when you sing this song at 59:54 because this is actually one of a few songs that got me into loving Visual Novel songs and still until now, I still listen to this song. Wait, Toki no Mahou by Setusna Ogiso at 1:19:00?? I actually have the acoustic version of this song in my playlist as the acoustic version is more sad for me, I still love this song along with POWDER SNOW acoustic version. At 1:27:56, After All -Tsuzuru no Omoi-, I also love this song a lot, especially Touma Kazusa version, because this song I can actually feel her feeling when she sings it, it's so good and most importantly at 1:51:23, Sakura, Moyu, my personal favourite as this is the song I listen to go to sleep because this song really sounded like a lullaby for me. Although Sakura, Moyu is actually a sad song, I still enjoy listening to this from time to time.
I'm so glad I finally catch up to your Visual Novel singing stream, I have been missing it like 2 and 3 times because I got work. But that doesn't mean I didn't listen to your archive because as a Visual Novel fan, your singing stream is a must for me and I am so glad I finally catch up tonight. As always, I will be looking forward to your Visual Novel singing stream, and I am sorry in advance if I miss some of your stream here and there, but I will catch up as soon as possible. Thank you for bringing me such an enjoyable night from these songs 🙏😁

sources.sourceText:
初見です
結構前にお勧めに出たアーカイブで「Powder Snow」を聞いた時からからたまにロムったりアーカイブでお世話になっています
今日はまたお勧めに出たここで"この方ならこの曲も歌ってるのでは？"と思ってた「I hope so」が聴けてとても嬉しかったです
タイムスタンプを残してくれるリスナーさんに感謝です
歌も原曲の雰囲気もよく活かしててうまかったし、音源の方の音量が若干だけ大きかったらもっと素敵だったんだろうと思いました
「Lunatic Tears」も久々に聴けて嬉しかったです

以前の配信で音源を依頼してるって聞いて、それにゲームの感想会もするほどこのジャンルに本気だっていうことが感じられてとてもすごいと思ってます
陰ながら応援してます




30:12 可愛かったです
